description.detail: The full layer emitted phenotype nodes, disease and protein phenotype edges and direct HPO subclass edges. Duplicate annotation rows per subject and phenotype were collapsed so a genuine annotation would not present as a pruning duplicate, which changed the edge counts without changing the graph revision.
description.numbers: terms 19,894; 24,390 subclass edges; disease_has_phenotype 13,279 → 12,606; protein_has_phenotype 19,239 → 15,379; 673 disease and 3,860 target duplicate rows; 29,406 nodes / 90,072 edges; 416/1,919 diseases and 245/635 targets mapped; revision 0d52adf01d8843c1
